method:
QA of the founder-approved Locke part_songOn AS NOW SHIPPED in assets/
(2026-10-18), by the method of final_corrections_review/tools/applied_qa.py:
exact manifest file name and FNV-1a fingerprint of the canonical script;
provenance (logged voice ID and script of the source take); script identity
by offline ASR (faster-whisper small.en) on the shipping .m4a; lead-in, tail,
last 10 ms, true peak; and that the file IS the approved performance
(waveform correlation of the decoded shipping speech against its source
take, trimmed and at the logged gain). Plus the defect check: the level of
the stretch between "really like" and "and let it play", where seed 30 had
~450 ms of voiced sound at speech level.
Usage: python -I applied_qa.py <repo>

voice_locke_v1/part_songOn.script: Put a song on. Put on a song you really like, and let it play while you start.
